subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does the workflow/security owner accept these exact action revisions for workflows that mint tokens, consume secrets, publish artifacts, upload security results, write repository state, and run Codex agents after a current-main refresh?
rationale: Automated review found no line-level defect, but accepting newly bundled third-party executable code at privileged workflow boundaries requires repository-owner trust judgment and direct Codex contract verification.

options.title: Refresh and approve exact pins
options.body: Regenerate or rebase the branch, complete all exact-head guards, directly inspect the Codex contract, and approve the grouped immutable revisions.

options.title: Split by trust boundary
options.body: Separate token, publishing, scanning, Codex-agent, and routine setup updates into smaller PRs for isolated review and rollback.

options.title: Retain current revisions
options.body: Pause or close this grouped update until an owner is available to review regenerated dependency pins.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve exact pins
recommendation.body: Regenerate or rebase the branch, complete all exact-head guards, directly inspect the Codex contract, and approve the grouped immutable revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline provides the strongest available direct stakeholder signal for this workflow and release-security decision.
